meals.name: Chicken Milanese with Tomato & Mozzarella Rigatoni
meals.description: Crisp Parmesan-breaded chicken breast with rigatoni in a smooth garlic and tomato sauce, torn mozzarella, Parmesan and basil.

substitutions.label: Use a pre-breaded chicken breast
substitutions.note: Skip the flouring and breading steps and cook the pre-breaded chicken according to its packet instructions. Keep the Parmesan for the pasta.

instructions: Blitz the bread into breadcrumbs and mix with 15 g of the Parmesan. Flatten the chicken to an even 1.5 cm thickness, season it, dredge in 25 g plain flour, dip in the beaten egg and coat with the Parmesan breadcrumbs.
Heat 3 tbsp neutral oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 4–5 minutes on each side, until crisp and cooked through to 75°C, then rest it on a rack for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan. Cook the crushed garlic for 30 seconds, add the canned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Immersion-blend until smooth and season to taste.
Boil the rigatoni in salted water according to the packet instructions. Reserve a splash of pasta water, drain, then toss through the tomato sauce, loosening it if necessary.
Fold through the torn mozzarella, remaining 15 g Parmesan and most of the basil. Serve beside the Milanese and finish with the remaining basil, keeping the sauce off the crust.

meals.name: Peanut Noodles with Charred Chicken Thigh & Cucumber Salad
meals.description: Charred soy-marinated chicken thighs over rich sesame-peanut noodles with a cold cucumber salad.
instructions: Marinate the chicken for 15 minutes with 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 crushed garlic clove and a little black pepper.
Heat a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes on each side, until charred and cooked through to 75°C. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Whisk 1½ tbsp sesame paste, 1½ tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil and ½ finely grated garlic clove. Whisk in about 60 ml hot noodle water until glossy.
Boil the noodles according to the packet instructions, drain and toss thoroughly through the sauce.

Thinly slice the cucumber, toss with ¼ tsp salt and leave for 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Mix 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp sugar and the remaining ½ finely grated garlic clove. Toss with the cucumber just before serving and finish with the sliced spring onions and 2 tsp sesame seeds.
Plate the noodles with the sliced chicken and cucumber salad, then finish with freshly ground black pepper.

meals.name: Pork Tenderloin, Mustard Cream Sauce, Mash & Spinach
meals.description: Seared pork tenderloin with a shallot, white wine, Dijon and wholegrain mustard cream sauce, buttery mash and wilted spinach.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into even chunks, cover with salted water and simmer for 15–18 minutes until tender. Drain, steam-dry for 2 minutes, then mash with 20 g butter and season.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Season the pork and sear for about 2 minutes on each side. Lower the heat and continue cooking, turning regularly, until the centre reaches 63°C. Rest for 8 minutes before slicing.

Dissolve ¼ chicken stock cube in 100 ml boiling water. In the pork pan, cook the finely chopped shallot and crushed garlic with the remaining 5 g butter for 2 minutes. Add the white wine and reduce by half.
Add the prepared stock and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp wholegrain mustard and the cream, then simmer gently for 2–3 minutes and season to taste.
Wilt the spinach in a covered pan with a splash of water for 2 minutes. Serve with the mash, sliced pork and mustard cream sauce.

meals.name: Air-Fried Miso Salmon, Soy & Egg Fried Rice, Tenderstem
meals.description: Air-fried salmon glazed with white miso, light soy and sesame oil, served with egg fried jasmine rice and charred tenderstem broccoli.
instructions: Rinse the rice, combine it with 195 ml water and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, then remove from the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes. Spread it on a plate for 10 minutes so excess steam can escape.

Preheat the air fryer to 190°C. Mix the white miso paste with 1 tbsp light soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil. Pat the salmon dry and spread the miso mixture over the flesh, keeping the skin mostly clean.
Lightly oil the air-fryer basket and place the salmon skin-side down. Air-fry for 8–10 minutes, depending on thickness, until lightly caramelised and cooked through to 63°C. Rest for 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tsp neutral oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Char the tenderstem for 5–6 minutes, adding a splash of water and covering briefly if necessary, then set aside.

Heat another 2 tsp neutral oil in the pan. Stir-fry the crushed garlic and sliced spring onions for 30 seconds, scramble in the eggs, then add the rice, 1 tbsp light soy sauce and 1 tsp dark soy sauce. Fry for 3–4 minutes and finish with 1 tsp sesame oil.
Serve the fried rice with the tenderstem and air-fried miso-soy salmon.

meals.name: Steak au Poivre, Frites & Dressed Salad
meals.description: Pan-seared ribeye with a brandy peppercorn cream sauce, crispy air-fryer chips and a lemon-Dijon dressed side salad.
instructions: Cook the frozen chips in an air fryer at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp, or follow the packet instructions.

Pat the ribeye dry and season generously with salt and 1 tsp coarsely cracked black pepper. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a heavy frying pan over high heat and sear for 2–3 minutes on each side, adjusting for thickness and preferred doneness. Add 10 g butter for the final minute and baste, then rest the steak for 8 minutes.

Dissolve ¼ beef stock cube in 100 ml boiling water. Lower the pan to medium heat and cook the finely chopped shallot in the remaining 5 g butter for 2 minutes. Add 25 ml brandy and simmer for 1 minute, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the prepared stock and reduce by half. Stir in the cream, ½ tsp Dijon mustard and another ½ tsp cracked black pepper, then simmer gently for 2–3 minutes.
Whisk 1 tbsp lemon juice with ½ tsp Dijon mustard and 1 tbsp olive oil. Toss with the salad leaves, then serve beside the chips, rested steak and peppercorn sauce.
